name: WaiterDock
tagline: Restaurant operations for a local restaurant: seating, orders, kitchen updates, inventory and a customer call button.
problem: The restaurant needed a modern system.
solution: A table-grid dashboard, real-time order updates to the kitchen, a customer menu with a waiter button, management stats and inventory.
demo_moment: Team-described: seat a party and send an order to the kitchen.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Mai Shan Yun Challenge” among 176 submissions.
Covers every function the restaurant asked for.

lessons: A real local client's checklist is the rubric.
